task_input: Harden core/scripts/gh.ts createIssue so it rejects a GitHub issue URL whose parsed issue number is not a positive safe integer. Preserve the existing successful behavior for a valid positive issue number. Add a focused regression test.

implementing.plan: Validate the parsed issue number after extracting it from the GitHub URL, reject zero/negative/unsafe values with a clear error, and add a regression test through the injected GhApiRunner seam.

hidden_checks: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import { createIssue } from './core/scripts/gh.ts'; const cfg={repo:'owner/repo'}; await createIssue(cfg,'title','body',[],async()=> 'https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/0').then(()=>process.exit(1),()=>process.exit(0));"

acceptance_criteria.statement: createIssue rejects a zero issue number parsed from an otherwise well-formed GitHub issue URL.
